result.instructions: Solar Studio Module 01. Deterministic flat-site table layout: validate_request, calculate_row_pitch, create_project/get_project/update_project, generate_layout, get_layout_summary, get_layout_items, export_layout. Module 02 (terrain placement, milestone T1): validate_terrain, import_terrain, get_terrain, place_on_terrain, get_placement_summary, get_placement_items, export_placement, verify_stored_placement. All coordinates are metres in the request frame (x East, y North); terrain elevations are in the terrain's declared vertical reference and are never transformed. Do not invent quantities; read them from results.

request.title: solar.layout.request/1
request.description: Flat-site layout request in an explicitly named metric Cartesian frame (x East, y North, metres). Structural rules only: geometry validity, the supported envelope, frame semantics and pitch feasibility are checked after this schema by the application and reported as typed field errors.

kind.description: local_cartesian or projected_cartesian; other values are rejected as UNSUPPORTED_FRAME.

crs.description: Required for projected_cartesian. Retained verbatim; no transformation is performed.

units.description: Must be "m"; other values are rejected as UNSUPPORTED_FRAME.

length_m.description: Long side (>= width_m). Supported envelope 0.05..10 m.

power_wp.description: Nameplate STC power; the only electrical rating used.

columns.description: Modules across the table width (along u).

module_gap_x_m.description: Gap between columns, in the table plane.

module_gap_y_m.description: Gap between rows, in the table plane.

facing_azimuth_deg.description: Clockwise from frame north; normalized to [0, 360).

lower_edge_height_m.description: Synthetic height of the lower edge above the layout's relative flat datum.

row_pitch_m.description: Lower edge to lower edge, horizontal, along v.

position.description: [x, y]. A third (Z) value is rejected after this schema as UNSUPPORTED_INPUT.

tools.description: Module 02: validate a TIN terrain surface (solar.terrain.surface/1: explicit counter-clockwise triangles, horizontal frame identical to the layout's, required vertical reference). Returns the terrain ID it would get, or typed errors. Stores nothing.

surface.title: solar.terrain.surface/1
surface.description: A triangulated ground surface (TIN) in the same metric Cartesian frame as a Module 01 layout, with an explicit vertical reference. Structural checks only. Semantic rules (counter-clockwise triangles, plan area, no plan overlap, no duplicate plan vertices, crack-free T-junctions, coordinate magnitudes and count limits) are enforced by the validator; see CONTRACTS.md section 2. For large surfaces the validator applies this schema to the document with the two arrays checked separately by the same rules.

frame.description: Identical object to the Module 01 request frame. Terrain and layout frames must be equal; no horizontal transformation is performed.

vertical.description: Vertical reference of every z value. Required; no default and no transformation between references.

vertices_xyz_m.description: Plan x (east), y (north) and elevation z. |x|, |y| <= 1e7 and |z| <= 2e4 are envelope limits (RESOURCE_LIMIT), checked by the validator.

triangles.description: Vertex index triples, counter-clockwise in plan. Coverage is exactly the closed union of these triangles; there is no implicit triangulation.

tools.name: import_terrain

tools.description: Module 02: read a stored terrain's identity, frame, vertical reference, counts and bounds (not its vertices).
tools.name: get_terrain

tools.description: Module 02: place a stored Module 01 layout (named by result_id and payload_digest) on a stored terrain by rigid vertical lift (policy minimum_clearance_vertical_lift). Each table keeps its XY geometry; uncovered footprints are unknown_ground; slope and support-height limits make tables infeasible. Independently verified before it is stored. Support heights are above-ground heights, not embedment depths or pile lengths.

request.title: solar.terrain.placement.request/1
request.description: Place a stored Module 01 layout result on a stored terrain surface by rigid vertical lift. Every parameter that changes the result is explicit; there are no hidden defaults. Semantic rules: CONTRACTS.md section 3.

source_layout.description: The Module 01 result, named by its result ID and payload digest together. Table IDs such as T_j0_i0 are unique only inside this layout.

policy.description: minimum_clearance_vertical_lift is the only policy in T1; any other value is UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION (validator).

structure_depth_m.description: Depth of structure below the module plane counted against clearance; 0 measures clearance to the module plane.

supports.description: Support positions come from an explicitly stated model; their number is not derived from table dimensions or module count. T1 supports only explicit_table_local (other models are UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION).

coverage.description: A table whose footprint is not wholly inside the TIN coverage is reported as unknown_ground and not placed. No interpolation across gaps and no extrapolation.

expected_vertical.description: Optional assertion of the terrain's complete vertical reference. Partial or empty assertions are rejected; any difference is DATUM_MISMATCH. Nothing is transformed.
